task.title: Creating the Red Hat Quay registry on infrastructure nodes
task.shortdesc: To create a Red Hat Quay registry that runs on infrastructure nodes, you can create a QuayRegistry custom resource in the annotated namespace. You must patch the registry components (clair, postgres, redis, and so on) with toleration annotations so they can schedule onto the infra worker nodes.

step.cmd: On the OpenShift Container Platform web console, click Operators → Installed Operators → Red Hat Quay.
On the Red Hat Quay Operator details page, click Quay Registry → Create QuayRegistry.
On the Create QuayRegistry page, set the monitoring and objectstorage fields to false. The monitoring component cannot be enabled when Red Hat Quay is installed in a single namespace. For example:

info.codeblock: # ... - kind: monitoring managed: false - kind: objectstorage managed: false # ...

step.cmd: Optional: Confirm that the pods are running on infra nodes.

substep.cmd: List all Quay-related pods along with the nodes that they are scheduled on by entering the following command:

info.codeblock: $ oc get pods -n <annotated_namespace> -o wide | grep example-registry
